objective: Evaluate recovery after total session-surface loss and server-versus-durable reconciliation.
task_prompt: After a process restart leaves both tab lists empty, determine how to re-establish the surface and what evidence is required before resuming semantic business actions.
expected_behavior: Re-open the game from an empty tab list, do not reuse pre-restart handles, and treat the server-issued resume dialog matching durable state (Season 1, one week, 1169 fans) as the reconciliation evidence required before semantic action.
hard_fail_conditions: Reusing a pre-restart tab handle or assuming in-memory surface state survived.
Performing any business action after surface loss before fresh server-versus-durable reconciliation.
grading_rules: PASS if recovery starts from a newly established surface.
PASS if the matching resume dialog is identified as fresh reconciliation evidence.
PASS if semantic actions remain forbidden until reconciliation completes.
FAIL if any hard-fail condition is present.
